newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Offer sees Illovo up Lonsug stake.
newsitem.headline: Offer sees Illovo up Lonsug stake.

text.p: Illovo Sugar Ltd had acquired 99.9 percent of Lonrho Sugar for 1.72 billion rand after shareholders approved to sell their combined stake to the group which is owned by CG Smith Limited.
The follows an announcement last month that Illovo had bought 94.25 percent of Lonrho Sugar Corporation Limited from UK firm Lonrho Plc for 1.62 billion rand, creating Africa's biggest sugar group.
CG Smith said in an announcement on Monday Illovo had financed 1.1 billion rand of the purchase price through the issue of new Illovo shares.
The balance of the consideration was being funded from existing Illovo cash resources and the issue of preference shares. it said.
CG Smith unit CG Smith Foods Ltd had subscribed for 37,6-million of the new Illovo shares, representing a total capital contribution of 320 million rand.
CG Smith had in turn raised 380 million rand through the issue of 15,3-million new CG Smith ordinary shares at 24,79 rand a share.
The 60 million rand balance would be used to repay funds raised last year when the group acquired additional shares in subsidiary Island View Holdings Limited.

As a result of the transactions, CG Smith Food's holdings in in Illovo would be reduced to 51.1 percent from 69 percent previously. CG Smith's holding in CG Foods had increased to 80.94 percent from 80.15 percent.
